title: [29.x][All-e][SaaS] Last name of the employee relative is not editable when customized using “Profile (Role)”
summary: The Last Name field for employee relatives is now visible and editable on the Employee Relatives page after being missing from the page layout.
key_points: Last Name field added to the Employee Relatives page layout
Field was present in the underlying table but not exposed in the UI
Automated UI test added to verify the field can be edited and saved
Fixes an issue where users could not view or edit employee relative last names
quote: Last name of the employee relative is not editable when customized using "Profile (Role)"
